hook: Every well-built text is held together by words like dieser, dabei and solche; follow them back and each missing sentence finds its place.
intro: Here a commentary has seven sentences removed and you put them back — and the only way to do it reliably is by the reference words, the same links that hold any well-written text together. Each removed sentence contains a link to what precedes it: a demonstrative (dieser Einwand — an objection must have just been made), a da-word (dabei — a process was just described), a generalising echo (das gilt für … — a claim was just stated), a pronoun with no antecedent in the sentence itself (eine solche Übermacht — something overpowering was just named). Read the text once for the argument's shape; then take each candidate sentence, underline its backward-pointing word, and find the gap whose left neighbour supplies the antecedent. Check the right neighbour too: the sentence must hand over to what follows (Es geht mithin nicht um Willensstärke needs a preceding sentence about power or tools). Connectors help — freilich concedes, gleichwohl contrasts, mithin concludes — but the reference words decide.
tips[0].title: Find the backward pointer in each candidate
tips[0].text: dieser Einwand → an objection precedes. dabei → an action/process precedes. das gilt für … → a general claim precedes. eine solche Übermacht → a description of overwhelming force precedes. Underline it, then look for the gap whose left neighbour matches.
tips[0].check.why: The demonstrative diese Entwicklung points back: the left neighbour must already have described a development.
tips[0].visual.blocks[0].label: the sentence before
tips[0].visual.blocks[1].label: the gap: points back
tips[0].visual.blocks[2].label: the sentence after
tips[1].title: Check the hand-over to the right
tips[1].text: The sentence after the gap continues from the candidate. 'Gegen eine solche Übermacht hilft kein guter Vorsatz' → 'Es geht mithin nicht um Willensstärke' (Vorsatz → Willensstärke). If the right neighbour doesn't follow, the gap is wrong.
tips[1].check.why: The right neighbour picks up the candidate: Sparplan leads to Disziplin. The rise in rents would come before it, since solche Preise needs it as an antecedent.
tips[2].title: Connectors are hints, references are proof
tips[2].text: freilich (concession), gleichwohl (contrast), mithin (conclusion), dabei (consequence within a process) tell you the kind of sentence; the demonstrative or pronoun tells you the exact place.
tips[2].check.why: freilich concedes a point ('admittedly'); mithin and folglich draw a conclusion, which doesn't fit here.
remember[0]: Underline the backward pointer; match it to the left neighbour; check the right neighbour.
remember[1]: dieser / solche / dabei / das gilt für: the four pointers that solve most gaps.
exam: Putting removed sentences back into a commentary is a standard reading task in the C1 exam.
tips[0].check.q: A missing sentence reads: „Diese Entwicklung war absehbar.“ What must the sentence right before the gap contain?
tips[0].check.options[0]: A description of a change or trend
tips[0].check.options[1]: An objection to the author's view
tips[0].check.answer: A description of a change or trend
